subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer observability be solved through a PluginStatusProvider-style SDK seam, a core `tui.footerTemplate` config surface, or only the existing `/status` and `/usage` surfaces?
rationale: The useful behavior is clear, but the durable boundary affects public Plugin SDK shape, core config, provider credential use, and live provider polling latency.

options.title: Plugin/API Footer Seam
options.body: Review or refresh the PluginStatusProvider path and add TUI rendering only after the SDK shape, ordering, truncation, and provider polling rules are accepted.

options.title: Core Config Template
options.body: Add a first-class `tui.footerTemplate`/field config surface with schema, docs, compatibility handling, and explicit credential-backed provider usage policy.

options.title: Keep Existing Surfaces
options.body: Keep provider quota and cost visibility in `/status` and `/usage` only, and narrow or close persistent footer customization as out of scope.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API Footer Seam
recommendation.body: Review or refresh the PluginStatusProvider path and add TUI rendering only after the SDK shape, ordering, truncation, and provider polling rules are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and provider-usage history tie this decision to the TUI/config and provider-usage boundaries.
